lastCompletedStory.title: Suppress plan split-advisory for single-story PRDs

nextStoryContext: maybeEmitPlanSplitAdvisory now returns early ('if (storyCount <= 1) return;') right after storyCount is computed, before the historical event-log read/bucketing/computeSplitAdvisory/logEvent/notify block. src/stats/split-advisory.ts (the pure heuristic/threshold) was left untouched per AC-4. New test 'US-001: single-story PRD stays silent even when the same-jobSize bucket would otherwise fire' reuses the AC2 fire fixture with storyCount=1 to prove suppression.
